description_en: Invokes ListGatewayTransferPackets to retrieve the statistics information of uplink and downlink packets of a gateway
description_zh: 调用ListGatewayTransferPackets获取网关上下行数据包的统计信息
kebab_example: aliyun linkwan list-gateway-transfer-packets --gw-eui 0000000000000000 --dev-eui 0000000000000001 --category DOWNLINK_PACKET --page-number 1 --page-size 2 --begin-millis 1514736000000 --end-millis 1514736000000 --sorting-field LOG_MILLIS --ascending true --api-version 2018-12-30 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListGatewayTransferPackets

parameters.help_en: The GwEUI of the gateway to query
parameters.name: gw_eui

parameters.help_en:
The packet category. Valid values:

DOWNLINK_PACKET: downlink packet
UPLINK_PACKET: uplink packet
INVALID_PACKET: invalid packet
parameters.help_zh:
数据包分类。取值：

DOWNLINK_PACKET：下行包
UPLINK_PACKET：上行包
INVALID_PACKET：无效包
parameters.name: category

parameters.help_en: The page size. The value must be greater than or equal to 1
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The start time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询开始时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: begin_millis

parameters.help_en: The end time of the query. The value is a UNIX timestamp in milliseconds
parameters.help_zh: 查询结束时间，毫秒为单位的UNIX时间戳
parameters.name: end_millis

parameters.help_en: The sorting field. Valid values: LOG_MILLIS, which sorts results by time
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段，取值：LOG_MILLIS，表示按照时间排序
parameters.name: sorting_field

parameters.help_en: Specifies the sort order. Used together with the SortingField parameter. A value of true indicates ascending order. A value of false indicates descending order
parameters.help_zh: 配合SortingField参数一起使用，true表示升序，false表示降序
parameters.name: ascending

List.description_en: The list of packets that match the filter conditions
List.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的数据包信息列表

ClassMode.description_en: The communication mode used to send or receive this packet
ClassMode.description_zh: 收发此数据包时的通信模式

Datr.description_en: The data rate for sending or receiving this packet
Datr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的数据速率

DevAddr.description_en: The network address of the node that sent or received this packet
DevAddr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的节点的网络地址

DevEui.description_en: The DevEUI of the node that sent or received this packet
DevEui.description_zh: 收发此数据包的节点的DevEUI

FPort.description_en: The FPort used to send or receive this packet
FPort.description_zh: 收发此数据包时所使用的FPort

Freq.description_en: The frequency used to send or receive this packet

GwEui.description_en: The GwEUI of the gateway through which this packet was sent or received
GwEui.description_zh: 收发此数据包所经过的网关的GwEUI

HasData.description_en: Indicates whether this packet contains business data
HasData.description_zh: 此数据包中是否包含业务数据

HasMacCommand.description_en: Indicates whether this packet contains MAC commands
HasMacCommand.description_zh: 此数据包中是否包含MAC指令

LogMillis.description_en: The UNIX timestamp of the packet transmission, in milliseconds
LogMillis.description_zh: 数据包传输的UNIX时间戳，以毫秒为单位

Lsnr.description_en: The signal-to-noise ratio for sending or receiving this packet
Lsnr.description_zh: 收发此数据包的信噪比

items.description_en: 这个数据包所携带的MAC指令列表
items.description_zh: 这个数据包所携带的MAC指令列表

MacPayloadSize.description_en: The length of the MACPayload message in this packet

MessageType.description_en:
The message type. Valid values:

JOIN_REQUEST: Join-request message
JOIN_ACCEPT: Join-accept message
UNCONFIRMED_UP: Unconfirmed uplink message
UNCONFIRMED_DOWN: Unconfirmed downlink message
CONFIRMED_UP: Confirmed uplink message
CONFIRMED_DOWN: Confirmed downlink message
REJOIN_REQUEST: Rejoin-request message
PROPRIETARY: Proprietary message
MessageType.description_zh:
消息类型，取值：

JOIN_REQUEST：Join-request消息
JOIN_ACCEPT：Join-accept消息
UNCONFIRMED_UP：Unconfirmed上行消息
UNCONFIRMED_DOWN：Unconfirmed下行消息
CONFIRMED_UP：Confirmed上行消息
CONFIRMED_DOWN：Confirmed下行消息
REJOIN_REQUEST：Rejoin-request消息
PROPRIETARY：Proprietary消息（私有消息）

NodeOwnerAliyunId.description_en: The Alibaba Cloud account ID of the node owner
NodeOwnerAliyunId.description_zh: 节点拥有者的阿里云账号ID

ProcessEvent.description_en:
The processing result of the packet. Valid values:

SUCCESS: Successful.
DEVADDR_ILLEGAL: The DevAddr is invalid.
MIC_FAIL: The MIC verification failed.
DEVEUI_ILLEGAL: The DevEui is invalid.
JOINEUI_ILLEGAL: The JoinEui is invalid.
STATUS_INVALID: The node status is invalid.
REDUPLICATE: Duplicate packet.
ISOLATED: Inter-network isolation.
APPKEY_ILLEGAL: The AppKey is invalid.
UPDATE_RUNTIME_CFG_FAIL: Failed to update the runtime configuration.
DELAY_PROCESS: Delayed processing.
GWEUI_ILLEGAL: The GwEui is invalid.
GW_STATUS_INVALID: The gateway status is invalid.
GW_FREQ_NOT_MATCH: The gateway frequency does not match.
Other: Unknown error
ProcessEvent.description_zh:
该报文的处理结果，取值：

SUCCESS：成功。
DEVADDR_ILLEGAL：DevAddr不合法。
MIC_FAIL：MIC校验失败。
DEVEUI_ILLEGAL：DevEui不合法。
JOINEUI_ILLEGAL：JoinEui不合法。
STATUS_INVALID：节点状态不合法。
REDUPLICATE：重复包。
ISOLATED：网间隔离。
APPKEY_ILLEGAL：AppKey不合法。
UPDATE_RUNTIME_CFG_FAIL：更新运行时配置失败。
DELAY_PROCESS：延迟处理。
GWEUI_ILLEGAL：GwEui不合法。
GW_STATUS_INVALID：网关状态不合法。
GW_FREQ_NOT_MATCH：网关频点不匹配。
其它：未知错误

Rssi.description_en: The RSSI for sending or receiving this packet

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of packets that match the filter conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 满足过滤条件的数据包总数

Success.description_en: Indicates whether the call was successful
